learning.title: Learn About Anxiety
learning.subtitle: Waves only stay for a moment. Learn how to let the wave of anxiety pass.

acc_01.text: The waves may rise high, but they will soon settle.
acc_01.subText: You don't have to force the anxiety away.

acc_02.text: These crashing waves are just a part of you, not all of you.
acc_02.subText: Anxiety is simply something that passes through.

acc_03.text: No matter how rough the waves, your center stays steady.
acc_03.subText: Take a breath and tune into what you feel right now.

val_01.text: Look beyond the waves to where you truly want to go.
val_01.subText: What matters most to you right now?

val_02.text: Wherever the waves push, holding your own direction is enough.
val_02.subText: What matters isn't the height of the waves—it's the direction you choose.

act_01.text: One small move right now can make a real difference.
act_01.subText: Even when anxious, what's the smallest thing you can start with?

act_02.text: The small steps you've taken will lead you where you want to be.
act_02.subText: There's real strength in the momentum your will creates.

act_03.text: Trust today's small steps over grand plans.
act_03.subText: Small actions add up to shape the life you value.

rest_01.text: It's okay to pause and rest. Stillness is part of living, too.
rest_01.subText: Give yourself permission to stop and just be.

rest_02.text: Instead of fighting the waves, let them pass and catch your breath.
rest_02.subText: You're doing more than enough, even without trying hard.
